newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures end down, near session lows.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures end down, near session lows.

text.p: Most U.S. debt futures ended lower, near session lows that were set in delayed reaction to the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to tighten money market conditions by a quarter of a percentage point.
The rate hike, which brings the federal funds rate to 5.50 percent, was widely anticipated by traders in the T-bond and Eurodollar pits.
However, once the Federal Open Market Committee made the announcement at about 1315 CST/1915 GMT, prices rallied sharply on short-covering.
Prices fell just as fast when short-covering dried up.
